# Course Delivery Change Log

Curriculum release: `<x.y.z>`  
Delivery baseline: `<identifier>`

Use one row for each classroom-facing change after the curriculum freeze.

| Date | Module/material | Type | Change | Reason | Supersedes distributed material? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YYYY-MM-DD | `<module/path>` | `errata` / `clarification` / `slides` / `lab-fix` / `setup` / `curriculum-change` | Short description | Why the change was needed | no / yes: `<artifact/revision>` |

## Rules

- Update canonical source first, then regenerate derivative artifacts.
- `errata`, `clarification`, `slides`, `lab-fix` and `setup` normally preserve the frozen curriculum when objectives and required scope do not change.
- `curriculum-change` requires explicit review against the course freeze/release record.
- If students already received an artifact, record whether it is still valid or superseded.
